scope: Local implementation of FE-1, the first packet after the QR-4 RO-8 feasibility check, for PM-1 rows F10-02 and F10-03: a pure fixed-input evaluator (quant_lab/src/robot_quant/fixed_eval.py) that runs one frozen parameter set on a new window without any search, reusing the engine's signal, Paper replay and period functions, and emits the records the QR-3 and QR-4 contracts need (bar-close fills with fee and slippage cost, NAV, return and drawdown, exposure, flat-to-flat episodes beside closed allocations, rejected intents with orphan exits split out, echoed engine and dataset hashes and lineage ids). It is outside every engine-hash closure, is not wired into any worker or job, and writes no run row.
method: The RO-8 feasibility check (independent architecture auditor, Opus 5.5) found the gaps and proposed FE-1. A coder wrote it; an independent auditor reviewed it twice; an independent tester ran single-edit mutations after each review and, in the last round, fuzzed the command-line driver. Root ruled on every finding (frozen dataset ATR, initial equity separate from cash, closed search refusal, exact policy keys, row time and capacity limits, a driver that always emits one JSON object with no traceback). Nobody verified their own work.
hashNote: SHA-256 of the line-feed content as Git stores it.
result: pytest tests/test_fixed_eval.py: 192 passed; full quant_lab suite: 511 passed; node --test test/fixed-eval-qr3-parity.test.js: 8 passed. The engine-hash closures (LEGACY, FOUNDATION, INGESTION, PF-2 engine and PF-2 evaluator) were recomputed before and after every round and did not change.
parity: With the frozen dataset ATR and the same capital, a fixed-input run equals the research engine's HOLDOUT path for the same window (fills and metrics), and its fills valued by the QR-3 valuation module give the same end NAV, return and drawdown; each fill's fee and slippage cost is recomputed independently in the Node test.

mutations.initial: 15 of 16 killed (one only by the Node parity test); the survivor and that pytest gap were closed in round 1.
mutations.round1: 20 of 25 killed; 2 test gaps closed in round 2, 3 equivalent.
mutations.round3: 3 of 4 killed; the survivor (allow_nan) has no reachable NaN source and stays as defence in depth.

limits: Pure evaluator only: lineage resolution, the zero-search worker mode, the QS-1 evaluation job class and admission (FE-2, QR-3 S3) do not exist yet.
Its result must not reach a run row until a versioned evaluation closure includes fixed_eval.py (FE-2 requirement).
Valid for cost model paper-close-v1 only.
The mode id (RO-7), the binding to the parent contract instead of the live deployment and the scope capital rule are root decisions before FE-2.
No staging readback and no PostgreSQL run.

rootAcceptance.statement: Root reviewed the agent reports, the rulings and the final diff and accepted FE-1 as local engineering evidence. Acceptance changes no PM-1 credit by itself and starts no evaluation.
